recipes.name: Chili con carne
recipes.dk: Chili med hakket kød, bønner & ris
steps: Fry the chopped onion, garlic and grated carrot in the oil for 3 min. Add the mince and brown it.
Stir in the paprika and spidskommen, then the diced pepper, chopped tomatoes and drained beans. Simmer 25 min and season with salt.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water. Serve with a spoon of skyr.

recipes.name: Whole-grain spaghetti bolognese
recipes.dk: Fuldkornspasta med kødsovs & grønt
steps: Fry chopped onion, garlic, grated carrot and diced squash in the oil for 5 min. Add the mince and brown it.
Add the tomatoes, salt and pepper. Simmer 20–25 min.
Boil the pasta in salted water and toss with the sauce.

recipes.name: Taco rice bowl
recipes.dk: Taco-skål med krydret kød, ris, bønner & grønt
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Brown the meat in the oil with the paprika, spidskommen, salt and a splash of water. Add the drained beans and heat through.
Chop the vegetables and build bowls of rice, meat and beans, vegetables and a spoon of skyr.

recipes.name: Frikadeller with potatoes & cabbage salad
recipes.dk: Frikadeller med kartofler & kål-æblesalat
steps: Mix the mince with grated onion, egg, milk, oats, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Rest 15 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Shape with a wet spoon and fry in the oil on medium heat, about 6 min per side.
Shred the cabbage finely, grate in the apple and stir with the skyr and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Hakkebøf with soft onions
recipes.dk: Hakkebøf med bløde løg, hjemmelavet sovs & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes and the vegetables in salted water.
Slice the onions and cook them slowly in half the butter for 15 min until soft and golden. Take them out.
Shape the mince into 4 patties, season with salt and pepper and fry in the rest of the butter, 4 min per side.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the milk and simmer 3 min for a sauce. Season and serve with the onions.

recipes.name: Flæskesteg with potatoes & fresh red cabbage
recipes.dk: Flæskesteg med kartofler & hurtig rødkål
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Rub plenty of salt into the scored rind and put the roast in a tin with 2 dl water.
Roast 1½ hours until 65°C in the middle. If the rind isn’t crackling, turn up to 250°C for the last 10 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Shred the red cabbage, cook it in the butter with the diced apple, a pinch of salt and 1 dl water for 20 min, covered.
recipes.tip: Cut the rind off if you want it leaner. Leftover slices are good cold on rye bread.

recipes.name: Cabbage & mince stew
recipes.dk: Kålgryde med hakket kød & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Brown the mince with the chopped onion in the oil in a large pot.
Add the shredded cabbage, sliced carrots and paprika and stir until the cabbage collapses, about 5 min.
Add the tomatoes and 3 dl water. Simmer 20 min, season with salt and pepper, and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Gyros bowl
recipes.dk: Gyros, ovnkartofler, kålsalat & tzatziki
steps: Toss potato wedges with most of the oil, salt and half the paprika. Roast at 220°C for 30–35 min.
Shred the cabbage and pepper finely and toss with a pinch of salt.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it dry and stir into the skyr with grated garlic and salt.
Fry the meat hard in the rest of the oil with the rest of the paprika and some salt, 5–6 min. Build the bowls.

recipes.name: Tray-roast chicken & vegetables
recipes.dk: Ovnbagt kyllingebryst med kartofler & grønt
steps: Toss potato chunks, onion wedges and vegetables with oil, salt and pepper and roast at 200°C for 15 min.
Season the chicken, add it to the tray and roast 20–25 min to 75°C in the middle.
Stir the skyr with grated garlic and a pinch of salt, and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Roast chicken legs with root veg
recipes.dk: Kyllingelår i ovn med kartofler & gulerødder
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss potatoes, carrots and onion wedges with oil and salt in a roasting tin.
Lay the chicken legs on top, skin up, and season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Roast 45 min until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.

recipes.name: Chicken & vegetable curry
recipes.dk: Kyllingekarry med grønt, kokosmælk & ris
steps: Fry the chopped onion in the oil, add the karry and fry 1 min.
Add the chicken in pieces and brown lightly.
Add coconut milk, pepper and the other vegetables. Simmer 12–15 min and season with salt.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water and serve together.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin with mushrooms
recipes.dk: Mørbrad med champignon, ris & broccoli
steps: Slice the tenderloin into medallions, season with salt and pepper and brown in the oil. Take them out.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the same pan with the paprika, add the creme fraiche and 1 dl water and simmer 3 min.
Return the meat and simmer 8–10 min.
Boil the rice and broccoli in lightly salted water and serve together.

recipes.name: Chicken & broccoli pasta
recipes.dk: Fuldkornspasta med kylling, broccoli & cremet sauce
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water, adding the broccoli for the last 3 min.
Fry the chicken in pieces in the oil with garlic, salt and pepper, 6–7 min.
Stir in the creme fraiche, a splash of pasta water and the grated cheese, then toss with the pasta and broccoli.

recipes.name: Chicken soup with vegetables
recipes.dk: Kyllingesuppe med gulerødder, porrer & ris
steps: Put the chicken, the onion in halves and 2 l water in a pot with the salt. Simmer 30 min, skimming now and then.
Take out the chicken, pull the meat off the bones and discard skin and bones.
Add the rice, sliced carrots and leek to the pot and simmer 15 min.
Return the chicken, season with salt and pepper and stir in the chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Salmon with roast potatoes & greens
recipes.dk: Laks med ovnkartofler & broccoli
steps: Toss halved potatoes with oil and salt and roast at 210°C for 20 min.
Add the salmon and greens to the tray, season with salt and pepper and roast 10–12 min more.
Serve with skyr seasoned with a pinch of salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Baked fish with rice & vegetables
recipes.dk: Ovnbagt fisk med ris & grøntsager
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Put the fish on a tray with the halved tomatoes, drizzle with half the oil, season and bake at 200°C for 12–15 min.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the rest of the oil with the soy sauce and serve together.

recipes.name: Shrimp stir-fry
recipes.dk: Wok med rejer, grøntsager & ris
steps: Boil the rice.
Stir-fry the garlic and vegetables in the oil on high heat for 4 min.
Add the shrimp and soy sauce and toss 2 min until hot.

recipes.name: Chickpea & vegetable curry
recipes.dk: Vegetarkarry med kikærter, blomkål & ris
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, add the karry and garlic for 1 min.
Add the drained chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and vegetables. Simmer 15 min, stir in the spinach and season with salt.
Boil the rice and serve together.

recipes.name: Potato & vegetable frittata
recipes.dk: Æggekage med kartofler, peberfrugt & salat
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 min, then slice.
Fry the potatoes, onion and pepper in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Pour over the eggs beaten with salt and pepper. Cook on low heat 8 min.
Top with the grated cheese, finish under the oven grill until set, and serve with the salad.

recipes.name: Red lentil dal with rice
recipes.dk: Dal med røde linser, spinat & ris
steps: Fry the chopped onion, garlic and grated ginger in the oil for 3 min. Add the karry and spidskommen for 1 min.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 8 dl water. Simmer 20 min, stirring now and then, until thick.
Stir in the spinach and season with salt.
Boil the rice and serve together.

recipes.name: Beef & root vegetable stew
recipes.dk: Oksegryde med rodfrugter & kartofler
steps: Brown the beef in batches in the oil in a heavy pot. Season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Add the onion, carrots in chunks and mushrooms, then the tomatoes and 5 dl water.
Simmer covered on low heat for 1½ hours until the meat is tender.
Boil the potatoes in salted water and serve with the stew.

recipes.name: Roast whole chicken with vegetables
recipes.dk: Helstegt kylling med kartofler & rodfrugter
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Put the halved lemon and garlic inside the chicken and rub it with oil, salt, pepper and paprika.
Toss potatoes, carrots and onion wedges with the rest of the oil and salt in a roasting tin and put the chicken on top.
Roast about 1¼ hours until the juices run clear at the thickest part of the leg.
Rest 10 min and cut into 8 pieces.

recipes.name: Pan-fried pork with apples & cabbage
recipes.dk: Stegt svinekød med æbler, sprød kål & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Season the pork with salt and pepper and fry it in the oil until done. Take it out.
Fry the shredded cabbage and sliced onion in the butter for 5 min, add the apple wedges and fry 3 min more.
Return the pork, heat through and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Salmon & spinach pasta
recipes.dk: Fuldkornspasta med laks, spinat & citron
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Cut the salmon into cubes and cook it gently in a pan with the creme fraiche and grated garlic for 4–5 min.
Stir in the spinach, the grated zest and juice of the lemon, salt and pepper, then the pasta and a splash of pasta water.

recipes.name: Fish & vegetable soup
recipes.dk: Fiskesuppe med tomat, porre & kartofler
steps: Soften the sliced leek, carrot and garlic in the oil for 5 min.
Add the diced potatoes, tomatoes, 8 dl water and the salt. Simmer 15 min.
Add the fish in chunks and simmer gently 5 min more. Season and serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle stir-fry
recipes.dk: Wok med kylling, nudler & grønt
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says and rinse them in cold water.
Stir-fry the chicken in strips in the oil with grated ginger and garlic, 5 min.
Add the vegetables and shredded cabbage and stir-fry 4 min, then the noodles and soy sauce until hot.

recipes.name: Sweet potato & bean chili
recipes.dk: Vegetarchili med søde kartofler & bønner
steps: Fry the chopped onion and pepper in the oil for 5 min, add the paprika, spidskommen and chili.
Add the sweet potatoes in cubes, the tomatoes, drained beans and 2 dl water. Simmer 25 min until the sweet potato is tender.
Season with salt and serve with a spoon of skyr.

recipes.name: Chicken thighs in tomato with bulgur
recipes.dk: Kyllingelår i tomat med squash & bulgur
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil, season with salt and oregano. Take it out.
Fry the onion, garlic, pepper and squash for 5 min, add the tomatoes and return the chicken. Simmer 20 min.
Cook the bulgur in lightly salted water as the pack says and serve together.

recipes.name: Stuffed peppers
recipes.dk: Fyldte peberfrugter med kød, ris & tomat
steps: Boil the rice for 8 min (it finishes in the oven). Heat the oven to 200°C.
Brown the mince and onion in the oil with salt and oregano, and mix with the rice and half the tomatoes.
Halve the peppers lengthways, fill them, put them on the rest of the tomatoes in a dish and top with the grated cheese.
Bake 25–30 min. Serve with the salad.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin with roast beetroot
recipes.dk: Mørbrad i ovn med rødbeder, kartofler & gulerødder
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss potatoes, beetroot and carrots in chunks with oil and salt and roast 25 min.
Brown the seasoned tenderloin in a hot pan, put it on the vegetables and roast 15–18 min to 65°C in the middle.
Rest 5 min, slice and serve with skyr stirred with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with rye bread
recipes.dk: Shakshuka: æg i krydret tomatsauce med rugbrød
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and sliced peppers in the oil for 8 min, add the paprika and spidskommen.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 min. Season with salt.
Make 8 hollows, crack an egg into each, cover and cook on low heat for 6–8 min until the whites are set.
Crumble the feta on top and serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Skyr bowl with fruit & oats
recipes.dk: Skyr med frugt & havregryn
steps: Spoon the skyr into a bowl.
Top with chopped fruit and the oats.

recipes.name: Porridge with fruit
recipes.dk: Havregrød med æble eller banan
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk with a pinch of salt for 5 min, stirring.
Top with the chopped fruit.

recipes.name: Banana-oat pancakes
recipes.dk: Bananpandekager med havregryn & skyr
steps: Mash the banana and whisk with the eggs and oats.
Fry small pancakes in a little oil, 2 min per side. Serve with skyr.

recipes.name: Overnight oats
recipes.dk: Overnight oats med skyr & frugt
steps: Stir the oats, skyr and milk together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight and top with fruit.

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs on rye
recipes.dk: Røræg på rugbrød med tomat
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and a splash of water.
Cook gently in the butter, stirring, until just set. Serve on the rye with tomato.

recipes.name: Yoghurt with oats & fruit
recipes.dk: Yoghurt naturel med havregryn & frugt
steps: Bowl, yoghurt, oats, fruit.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese on rye
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med hytteost & grønt
steps: Top two slices of rye with the cottage cheese.
Add sliced vegetables and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Egg & vegetable muffins
recipes.dk: Æggemuffins med grønt (lav dem til flere dage)
steps: Whisk the eggs with salt, stir in the chopped vegetables and grated cheese.
Pour into a muffin tin (or silicone cups) and bake at 180°C for 18–20 min. They keep 4 days in the fridge.
Eat with a slice of rye.

recipes.name: Skyr with berries & nuts
recipes.dk: Skyr med bær & nødder
steps: Top the skyr with berries, chopped nuts and the oats.

recipes.name: Avocado & egg on rye
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med avocado & blødkogt æg
steps: Boil the egg 6½ min and cool it in cold water.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt, spread on the rye and top with the halved egg.

recipes.name: Berry smoothie
recipes.dk: Smoothie med bær, banan, skyr & havregryn
steps: Blend everything smooth. Add a little more milk if it is too thick.

recipes.name: Peanut butter & banana on rye
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med peanutbutter & banan
steps: Spread the peanut butter on the rye and top with sliced banana.

recipes.name: Rye bread with smoked fish
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med røget fisk & grønt
steps: Spread a little skyr on two slices of rye.
Add the fish and the sliced vegetables.

recipes.name: Crunchy chicken salad
recipes.dk: Kyllingesalat med kål, æble & skyr-dressing
steps: Season the chicken with salt and fry in the oil, 5–6 min per side. Cool and slice.
Toss the shredded cabbage, vegetables and diced apple with the skyr and a pinch of salt.
Top with the chicken and serve with a slice of rye.

recipes.name: Tuna & egg on rye
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med tunsalat, æg & agurk
steps: Boil the egg 8 min and slice it.
Mix the tuna with the skyr and a pinch of salt.
Spread on two slices of rye and top with egg and vegetables.

recipes.name: Egg & tomato on rye
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med æg & tomat
steps: Boil the eggs 8 min, cool and slice.
Butter the rye thinly and layer with egg, tomato and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Pasta salad box
recipes.dk: Fuldkornspastasalat med kylling eller tun
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water and cool it under cold water.
If using chicken, fry it in the oil with a pinch of salt and slice.
Mix with the chopped vegetables and the skyr, and season with salt.

recipes.name: Bean & vegetable soup
recipes.dk: Grøntsagssuppe med bønner & rugbrød
steps: Soften the sliced leek in the oil with the paprika.
Add diced potatoes and carrots, the tomatoes, drained beans and 1 l water.
Simmer 25 min and season with salt and pepper. Serve with rye bread. Keeps 4 days.

recipes.name: Potato & leek soup
recipes.dk: Kartoffel-porresuppe med rugbrød
steps: Soften the sliced leek and onion in the butter for 5 min.
Add the diced potatoes and 1 l water with the salt. Simmer 20 min and blend smooth.
Stir in the creme fraiche and parsley and season. Serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Rye bread with cheese & veg
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med ost & grønt
steps: Top two slices of rye with the cheese and plenty of sliced vegetables.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with vegetables
recipes.dk: Stegte ris med æg & grønt
steps: Boil the rice and let it steam dry (or cook it the night before).
Stir-fry the vegetables in the oil, push them aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and soy sauce and toss until hot.

recipes.name: Rye bread with mackerel in tomato
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med makrel i tomat & agurk
steps: Spread the mackerel on two slices of rye.
Top with sliced cucumber and a few thin onion rings.

recipes.name: Bean salad with feta
recipes.dk: Bønnesalat med tomat, agurk & feta
steps: Rinse and drain the beans.
Mix with the chopped tomato and cucumber, the crumbled feta, oil, lemon juice and salt. Rye on the side.

recipes.name: Bulgur salad with chicken
recipes.dk: Bulgursalat med kylling, persille & citron
steps: Cook the bulgur as the pack says and let it cool.
Fry the chicken in a little of the oil with salt and slice it.
Mix the bulgur with the chopped vegetables, parsley, lemon juice, the rest of the oil and salt. Top with the chicken.

recipes.name: Tomato & lentil soup
recipes.dk: Tomatsuppe med røde linser & rugbrød
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and grated carrot in the oil for 5 min.
Add the tomatoes, rinsed lentils and 6 dl water. Simmer 20 min and blend smooth.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with rye bread. Keeps 4 days.

recipes.name: Potato on rye (kartoffelmad)
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med kartofler, skyr-dressing & tomat
steps: Boil the potatoes (or use cold ones), cool and slice them.
Spread a little skyr on the rye, layer the potato slices, tomato and a little chopped onion, and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Stegt flæsk with parsley sauce
recipes.dk: Stegt flæsk med kartofler & persillesovs
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Fry the pork slices crisp in a dry pan, 8–10 min, pouring off fat as you go. Salt them lightly.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the milk. Simmer 5 min, season with salt and stir in the chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Medister with creamed cabbage
recipes.dk: Medister med stuvet hvidkål & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water. Fry the medister in a little of the butter on medium heat for 20–25 min, turning.
Boil the shredded cabbage in salted water for 5 min and drain well.
Simmer the rest of the butter with the cream for 3 min, fold in the cabbage and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
recipes.dk: Pasta carbonara med bacon
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Fry the bacon crisp. Whisk the eggs with the grated cheese and plenty of pepper.
Off the heat, toss the drained pasta with the bacon, then the egg mix and a splash of pasta water until glossy.

recipes.name: Biksemad with fried egg
recipes.dk: Biksemad med pølser & spejlæg
steps: Dice the potatoes small and fry them in most of the oil for 15–20 min until golden and cooked through.
Fry the diced meat and onion in another pan, then mix everything and season with salt and pepper.
Fry one egg per person in the last of the oil and put it on top.

recipes.name: Burgers with oven fries
recipes.dk: Burger med ost & ovnfritter
steps: Cut the potatoes into fries, toss with the oil and salt and bake at 220°C for 30–35 min, turning once.
Shape the mince into 4 patties, season with salt and pepper and fry 3–4 min per side. Put the cheese on for the last minute.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with salad, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Soft tacos
recipes.dk: Tortillas med krydret kød, ost & grønt
steps: Brown the meat in the oil, then stir in the tacokrydderi and 1 dl water. Simmer 5 min.
Chop the vegetables. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Everyone fills their own with meat, vegetables, creme fraiche and cheese.

recipes.name: Hakkebøf with brown sauce
recipes.dk: Hakkebøf med bløde løg, brun sovs & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Slice the onions and cook them slowly in half the butter for 15 min until soft and golden.
Shape the mince into 4 patties, season and fry in the rest of the butter, 4 min per side.
Warm the brown sauce in the pan and serve with the onions and potatoes.

recipes.name: Sausage pasta in tomato sauce
recipes.dk: Pasta med pølser & tomatsauce
steps: Fry the chopped onion, garlic and sliced sausages in the oil for 5 min.
Add the tomatoes and paprika and simmer 10 min. Season with salt.
Boil the pasta in salted water and toss with the sauce.

recipes.name: Rolls with butter & cheese
recipes.dk: Boller med smør & ost
steps: Warm the rolls in the oven for 5 min.
Split them, butter and add the cheese.

recipes.name: Eggs & bacon on toast
recipes.dk: Toast med spejlæg & bacon
steps: Fry the bacon crisp, then fry the eggs in the same pan.
Toast and butter the bread and put the eggs and bacon on top.

recipes.name: Danish pancakes with sugar
recipes.dk: Pandekager med sukker
steps: Whisk flour, egg, milk, a pinch of salt and a little of the sugar into a smooth batter. Rest 10 min.
Fry thin pancakes in a little butter, 1 min per side.
Sprinkle with sugar and roll up.

recipes.name: Leverpostej with bacon & mushrooms
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med lun leverpostej, bacon & champignon
steps: Fry the bacon crisp, then the sliced mushrooms in the same pan.
Warm the leverpostej in the oven or pan.
Spread on rye and top with bacon and mushrooms.

recipes.name: Ham & cheese toastie
recipes.dk: Parisertoast med skinke & ost
steps: Fill the bread with ham and cheese, butter the outsides.
Toast in a pan, 3 min per side, until golden and melted.

recipes.name: Tuna wrap
recipes.dk: Wrap med tun, creme fraiche & grønt
steps: Mix the tuna with the creme fraiche and a pinch of salt.
Fill the tortillas with greens and the tuna mix, and roll them tight.

recipes.name: Homemade pizza
recipes.dk: Hjemmelavet pizza med skinke & champignon
steps: Heat the oven to 230°C. Roll the dough out on two baking trays.
Spread the tomatoes seasoned with oregano and salt, then the ham, sliced mushrooms, pepper and torn mozzarella.
Bake 12–15 min until golden. Cut each pizza into 8 slices.

recipes.name: Lasagne
recipes.dk: Lasagne med kødsovs & ostesauce
steps: Make a meat sauce: brown the mince with onion and grated carrot, add the tomatoes, salt and pepper and simmer 15 min.
Make a white sauce: melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the milk, and simmer 5 min. Season with salt.
Layer meat sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce in a dish, three times, and top with the grated cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 35–40 min. Serve with the salad.

recipes.name: Bacon & leek tart
recipes.dk: Tærte med bacon, porre & ost
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a tart tin with the pastry and bake it blind for 10 min.
Fry the bacon and sliced leek for 5 min and spread them in the case.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, grated cheese, salt and pepper, pour over and bake 30 min until set. Serve with the salad.

recipes.name: Sausages with mash
recipes.dk: Pølser med kartoffelmos & rødbeder
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water, mash them with the warm milk and butter and season with salt.
Boil the beetroot until tender (or roast them) and slice.
Fry or heat the sausages and serve with the mash and beetroot.

recipes.name: Kylling i karry
recipes.dk: Kylling i karry med flødesovs, æble & ris
steps: Fry the chicken in pieces in the butter, then the onion. Sprinkle over the karry and flour and fry 1 min.
Add the cream and 2 dl water, simmer 10 min, and add the diced apple for the last 3 min. Season with salt.
Boil the rice and serve together.

recipes.name: Cheese & bean quesadillas
recipes.dk: Quesadillas med ost, bønner & peber
steps: Fill the tortillas with grated cheese, beans and diced pepper and fold them.
Toast in a dry pan, 2 min per side, until the cheese melts. Serve with creme fraiche.

recipes.name: Fish cakes with potatoes & carrot salad
recipes.dk: Fiskefrikadeller med kartofler, gulerodssalat & dildskyr
steps: Blend or finely chop the fish with the grated onion, egg, flour, salt and pepper to a firm mixture and chill 15 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water, about 20 min.
Shape 12 fish cakes with a wet spoon and fry them in the oil on medium heat, 4 min per side.
Grate the carrots and apple, toss with the lemon juice and diced cucumber. Stir the skyr with chopped dill and a pinch of salt and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Teriyaki-style salmon with rice & greens
recipes.dk: Laks i soja-ingefærglace med ris, kål & broccoli
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Stir the soy sauce, honey, grated ginger and garlic with 3 tbsp water.
Brown the salmon pieces skin-side down in half the oil for 4 min, turn, pour over half the sauce and cook 3 min until glossy.
Stir-fry the shredded cabbage, carrot strips and broccoli in the rest of the oil with the rest of the sauce for 4 min and serve with the salmon and rice.

recipes.name: Thai-style shrimp & coconut curry
recipes.dk: Thailandsk karry med rejer, kokosmælk, basilikum & ris
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Fry the sliced onion, grated ginger and garlic in the oil for 3 min, then the karry and chili flakes for 1 min.
Add the coconut milk, soy sauce, pepper strips and squash and simmer 8 min.
Add the shrimp and spinach and heat 2–3 min. Finish with lemon juice and torn basil.

recipes.name: Tuna & tomato pasta with lemon
recipes.dk: Fuldkornspasta med tun, tomat, citron & persille
steps: Fry the chopped onion, garlic and diced squash in the oil for 5 min, add the chili flakes and tomatoes and simmer 10 min.
Boil the pasta in salted water.
Stir the drained tuna, spinach, lemon zest and juice into the sauce, season with salt and pepper, and toss with the pasta and chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Greek baked fish with tomatoes & potatoes
recipes.dk: Græsk ovnfisk (plaki) med tomat, løg & kartofler
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss sliced potatoes, onions and pepper with half the oil, salt and the oregano in a roasting dish and bake 25 min.
Stir the chopped tomatoes with the grated garlic and spread over the vegetables with the sliced fresh tomatoes.
Lay the fish on top, season with salt and pepper, drizzle with the rest of the oil and the lemon juice and bake 15–18 min until it flakes.
Scatter with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Mackerel, potato & beetroot salad
recipes.dk: Salat med makrel i tomat, kartofler, rå rødbede & æg
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 min and the eggs for 8 min; cool both and cut into chunks.
Slice the onion thinly and toss with the vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Stir the skyr with the mustard, chopped dill, salt and pepper.
Toss the lettuce, cucumber, grated raw beetroot, potatoes and onion, top with the mackerel and halved eggs, and spoon over the dressing.

recipes.name: Poached cod with mustard sauce
recipes.dk: Pocheret torsk med sennepssauce, kartofler & gulerødder
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water, and boil the carrots and broccoli alongside for the last 8 min.
Season the fish with salt and pepper and poach it in a pan of just-simmering salted water for 6–8 min.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the milk a little at a time. Simmer 3 min, stir in the mustard and season with salt.
Serve the fish with the sauce, potatoes and vegetables, scattered with parsley.

recipes.name: Tikka-spiced salmon with roast cauliflower
recipes.dk: Tikka-krydret laks med ovnbagt blomkål, yoghurt & ris
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss cauliflower florets, onion wedges and halved tomatoes with half the oil, half the karry, the spidskommen and salt and roast 15 min.
Stir half the yoghurt with the paprika, the rest of the karry, grated ginger and garlic, the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, and coat the salmon in it.
Add the salmon to the tray and roast 12–14 min.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water and serve with the spinach and the rest of the yoghurt.

recipes.name: Shrimp & vegetable paella
recipes.dk: Paella med rejer, peberfrugt, ærter & paprika
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and diced pepper in the oil in a wide pan for 5 min, then stir in the paprika and rice for 1 min.
Add the tomatoes, 8 dl water and the salt and simmer uncovered, without stirring, for 15 min.
Press the shrimp and vegetables into the rice and cook 5–7 min more until the rice is tender and the liquid is gone.
Rest 5 min under a lid, scatter with parsley and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Chermoula fish with chickpeas & bulgur
recipes.dk: Nordafrikansk fisk med chermoula, kikærter, tomat & bulgur
steps: Blend or finely chop the parsley with the garlic, spidskommen, paprika, chili flakes, lemon juice, half the oil and a pinch of salt to make the chermoula.
Fry the onion, pepper and grated carrot in the rest of the oil for 5 min, add the tomatoes and drained chickpeas and simmer 10 min. Season with salt.
Rub half the chermoula onto the fish, lay it on the sauce, cover and simmer gently 8 min until it flakes.
Cook the bulgur in lightly salted water as the pack says and serve with the rest of the chermoula.

recipes.name: Red lentil bolognese
recipes.dk: Fuldkornspasta med linsesovs, gulerod & champignon
steps: Fry the chopped onion, garlic, grated carrot and finely chopped mushrooms in the oil for 8 min.
Stir in the tomato paste and oregano, then the rinsed lentils, the tomatoes and 4 dl water. Simmer 20 min until thick and season with salt and pepper.
Boil the pasta in salted water, toss with the sauce and grate the cheese over.

recipes.name: Greek baked beans with feta
recipes.dk: Græske ovnbagte bønner i tomat med spinat, feta & rugbrød
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Fry the onion, garlic, grated carrot and diced pepper in half the oil for 6 min.
Add the tomatoes, spinach, oregano, drained beans, 1 dl water, salt and pepper, and pour into an oven dish.
Crumble the feta on top, drizzle with the rest of the oil and bake 30 min.
Scatter with parsley and serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Baked falafel with bulgur & salad
recipes.dk: Ovnbagte falafler med bulgur, salat & citronskyr
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Blend or mash the drained chickpeas with the onion, garlic, half the parsley, the spidskommen, flour, baking powder and half the salt to a coarse paste.
Shape 20 balls, flatten them slightly, brush with the oil on a lined tray and bake 25 min, turning halfway.
Cook the bulgur in lightly salted water. Chop the tomato, cucumber and lettuce and toss with the rest of the parsley and half the lemon juice.
Stir the skyr with the rest of the lemon and a pinch of salt and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Harira lentil & chickpea soup
recipes.dk: Marokkansk harira med linser, kikærter & rugbrød
steps: Fry the onion, garlic, grated ginger and diced carrot in the oil for 5 min. Add the spidskommen, cinnamon, paprika and tomato paste for 1 min.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, diced squash, drained chickpeas and 1.5 l water and simmer 25 min.
Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice, stir in the chopped parsley and serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Mexican bean & corn rice skillet
recipes.dk: Mexicansk risret med bønner, majs, peberfrugt & avocado
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and diced pepper in the oil for 5 min, then stir in the spidskommen, paprika, chili flakes and rice.
Add the tomatoes, 6 dl water and the salt, cover and simmer 15 min.
Stir in the drained beans and corn, top with the grated cheese, cover and leave 5 min off the heat.
Dice the avocado and fresh tomatoes with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, and serve on top with skyr.

recipes.name: Minestrone with beans & pasta
recipes.dk: Italiensk grøntsagssuppe med bønner, kål & fuldkornspasta
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and diced carrot in the oil for 5 min.
Add the diced squash, shredded cabbage, tomatoes, oregano and 1.5 l water and simmer 15 min.
Add the pasta and drained beans and simmer 10 min more until the pasta is tender. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with torn basil, grated cheese and rye bread.

recipes.name: Roast cauliflower & chickpeas with garlic skyr
recipes.dk: Ovnbagt blomkål & kikærter med hvidløgsskyr, mandler & bulgur
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss cauliflower florets, drained chickpeas, onion wedges and pepper strips with the oil, spidskommen, paprika and salt, and roast 30 min.
Cook the bulgur in lightly salted water as the pack says, and stir in the chopped parsley and half the lemon juice.
Stir the skyr with grated garlic, the rest of the lemon and a pinch of salt.
Chop the nuts, scatter them over the tray and serve with the bulgur and garlic skyr.

recipes.name: Baked feta & tomato pasta with beans
recipes.dk: Ovnbagt feta med tomater, spinat, bønner & fuldkornspasta
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Put the feta in the middle of an oven dish with halved tomatoes, diced pepper, sliced onion and garlic around it. Drizzle with the oil and season with oregano, chili flakes and black pepper.
Bake 25 min until the tomatoes burst.
Boil the pasta in salted water.
Mash the feta and tomatoes into a sauce, stir in the spinach and drained beans until wilted, then toss with the pasta and torn basil.

recipes.name: Coconut, mushroom & noodle soup with egg
recipes.dk: Thailandsk kokossuppe med champignon, nudler & æg
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 min, cool and peel them.
Fry the sliced mushrooms, grated ginger and garlic in the oil for 4 min.
Add the coconut milk, 1 l water, soy sauce, chili flakes, carrot strips and sliced pepper and simmer 8 min.
Add the noodles and shredded cabbage and simmer 4 min. Season with lemon juice and salt.
Serve in bowls topped with the halved eggs and basil.

recipes.name: Beetroot & feta patties with potatoes
recipes.dk: Rødbedebøffer med feta, kartofler, agurkesalat & dildskyr
steps: Grate the raw beetroot and onion, squeeze out some juice, and mix with the oats, eggs, crumbled feta, salt and pepper. Rest 10 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Shape 8 patties and fry them in the oil on medium heat, 4–5 min per side.
Stir the skyr with chopped dill and a pinch of salt, and serve with the potatoes and a cucumber and lettuce salad.

recipes.name: Spanish chickpea & spinach stew
recipes.dk: Spansk gryde med kikærter, spinat, paprika & æg
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and diced pepper in the oil for 5 min, then stir in the paprika and spidskommen for 30 sec.
Add the tomatoes, drained chickpeas and 1 dl water and simmer 10 min. Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until wilted.
Season with the vinegar, salt and pepper. Boil the eggs for 8 min, halve them and serve on the stew with rye bread.

recipes.name: Mushroom & bean stroganoff
recipes.dk: Stroganoff med champignon, bønner, paprika & ris
steps: Fry the sliced mushrooms in the oil on high heat for 6 min until browned, then add the onion and garlic for 3 min.
Stir in the paprika and tomato paste, then the drained beans, creme fraiche, mustard and 1.5 dl water. Simmer 8 min and season with salt and pepper.
Boil the rice and broccoli in lightly salted water and serve with parsley on top.

recipes.name: Lentil cottage pie with carrot mash
recipes.dk: Linsetærte uden dej: linser i tomat under kartoffel-gulerodsmos
steps: Boil the potatoes and half the carrots in salted water for 20 min, then mash with the milk, butter, salt and pepper.
Fry the onion, garlic, the rest of the carrots diced and the mushrooms in the oil for 6 min. Add the tomato paste, thyme, rinsed lentils, tomatoes, soy sauce and 3 dl water and simmer 15 min.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Spread the lentils in a dish, top with the mash and grated cheese and bake 20 min until golden.

recipes.name: Indian egg curry with spinach
recipes.dk: Indisk æggekarry med tomat, spinat, blomkål & ris
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 min, cool and peel them.
Fry the onion, garlic and grated ginger in the oil for 5 min, then the karry, spidskommen and chili flakes for 1 min.
Add the tomatoes and cauliflower florets and simmer 15 min. Stir in the spinach and yoghurt, season with salt and add the halved eggs to heat through.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water and serve with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Chinese tomato & egg stir-fry
recipes.dk: Kinesisk tomat-æggewok med ris & broccoli
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble them softly in half the oil; take them out while still soft.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the rest of the oil, add the tomato wedges and broccoli, the soy sauce, honey and 3 tbsp water and cook 4 min until saucy.
Fold the eggs back in and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki cabbage pancakes
recipes.dk: Japanske kålpandekager med æg, porre & tomat-sojasauce
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, a pinch of salt and 1 dl water to a thick batter, then fold in the finely shredded cabbage, grated carrot and sliced leek.
Fry 8 small pancakes in the oil on medium heat, 4 min per side, until golden and cooked through.
Stir the tomato paste with the soy sauce, honey and 1 tbsp water for a sauce.
Serve the pancakes with the sauce, a spoon of skyr and the sliced cucumber.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma with bulgur salad
recipes.dk: Ovnbagt kyllingeshawarma med bulgursalat & hvidløgsskyr
steps: Toss the chicken strips with the spidskommen, paprika, cinnamon, half the garlic, half the lemon juice, half the oil and salt, and leave 15 min.
Heat the oven to 220°C. Spread the chicken and onion wedges on a tray and roast 18–20 min until charred at the edges.
Cook the bulgur in lightly salted water, then toss with chopped tomato, cucumber, lettuce, parsley, the rest of the oil and lemon.
Stir the skyr with the rest of the garlic and a pinch of salt and serve.

recipes.name: Thai basil chicken with fried egg
recipes.dk: Pad kra pao: hakket kylling med basilikum, ris & spejlæg
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Stir-fry the garlic, chili flakes and sliced onion in most of the oil for 1 min, add the chicken and fry on high heat until browned, 5 min.
Add the pepper strips and broccoli, the soy sauce, honey and 3 tbsp water and toss 3 min. Stir in the basil.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil and serve on the rice with the sliced cucumber.

recipes.name: Lean chicken tikka masala
recipes.dk: Kylling tikka masala med skyr, tomat, blomkål & ris
steps: Coat the chicken pieces in half the skyr with half the karry, the paprika and salt, and leave 15 min.
Brown the chicken in half the oil in a hot pan, 5 min, and take it out.
Fry the onion, garlic and grated ginger in the rest of the oil for 5 min, add the rest of the karry, the spidskommen, cinnamon and tomato paste, then the tomatoes and cauliflower. Simmer 12 min.
Return the chicken and simmer 5 min, then take off the heat and stir in the rest of the skyr. Boil the rice in lightly salted water and serve.

recipes.name: Greek lemon-oregano chicken & potatoes
recipes.dk: Græsk citronkylling med oregano, kartofler & bondesalat
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss potato wedges, onion and pepper in a roasting tin with half the oil, the oregano, salt, the juice of one lemon and 1 dl water.
Rub the chicken legs with the rest of the oil, the grated garlic, salt and pepper and lay them on top, skin up.
Roast 50 min until the skin is crisp and the potatoes have soaked up the juices.
Chop the cucumber and tomato, top with crumbled feta and a squeeze of the second lemon, and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Chicken tinga bowls
recipes.dk: Mexicansk trukket kylling i krydret tomat med ris, bønner, kålsalat & avocado
steps: Fry the sliced onion and garlic in the oil for 5 min, add the paprika, spidskommen, oregano and chili flakes, then the tomatoes and 1 dl water. Add the chicken whole, cover and simmer 15 min.
Shred the chicken in the sauce with two forks and season with salt.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water and warm the drained beans with a pinch of salt.
Shred the cabbage finely and toss with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Serve with diced avocado and skyr.

recipes.name: Chicken satay with peanut sauce
recipes.dk: Kyllingesatay med peanutsauce, ris & sprød agurkesalat
steps: Toss the chicken strips with half the soy sauce, the karry and the grated garlic and ginger, and leave 15 min.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water. Fry the chicken in the oil on high heat, 6–7 min until golden.
Warm the peanut butter with the coconut milk, the rest of the soy sauce, the honey and the lemon juice, stirring until smooth.
Toss the sliced cucumber, grated carrot and shredded cabbage with the vinegar and a pinch of salt, and serve everything with the sauce.

recipes.name: Kung pao-style chicken
recipes.dk: Kinesisk wok med kylling, peberfrugt, nødder & ris
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water. Toss the chicken cubes with half the soy sauce and the flour.
Stir the rest of the soy sauce with the vinegar, honey and 4 tbsp water.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil on high heat for 5 min, add the chili flakes, garlic, ginger, onion and diced vegetables and fry 4 min more.
Pour in the sauce, toss until glossy and scatter with the chopped nuts.

recipes.name: Moroccan chicken tagine with bulgur
recipes.dk: Marokkansk kyllingegryde med gulerødder, kikærter, rosiner & bulgur
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in the oil with a little salt and take them out.
Fry the onion, garlic and grated ginger for 3 min, add the spidskommen, cinnamon and paprika, then the carrots in chunks, the tomatoes, drained chickpeas, raisins and 2 dl water.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer 25 min, adding the diced squash for the last 10 min. Season with salt.
Cook the bulgur in lightly salted water and finish the tagine with lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken, mushroom & spinach risotto
recipes.dk: Risotto med kylling, champignon, squash & spinat
steps: Fry the chicken in pieces in half the oil with salt and pepper until golden, then take it out.
Fry the onion, garlic and sliced mushrooms in the rest of the oil for 5 min, then stir in the rice and thyme for 1 min.
Add 1 l hot water a ladle at a time with the rest of the salt, stirring often, for about 18 min until creamy; add the diced squash halfway.
Stir in the chicken, spinach, grated cheese, lemon juice and parsley, and season with black pepper.

recipes.name: Chicken in leek & mustard sauce
recipes.dk: Kylling i porre-sennepssauce med champignon & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Brown the chicken strips in the oil, season with salt and pepper and take them out.
Fry the sliced leek, carrot and mushrooms for 6 min, add the milk, creme fraiche, mustard and 1 dl water and simmer 5 min.
Return the chicken, simmer 5 min until cooked through and scatter with parsley.

recipes.name: Pork larb with rice & crisp salad
recipes.dk: Thailandsk larb med hakket svinekød, citron, basilikum & ris
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Fry the mince and garlic in the oil on high heat, breaking it up, until browned and dry, 6–8 min.
Take off the heat and stir in the finely sliced onion, chili flakes, lemon juice and soy sauce, then the torn basil.
Serve with the rice, lettuce leaves, sliced cucumber, grated carrot and shredded cabbage.

recipes.name: Pork goulash with peppers
recipes.dk: Gullasch af svinekød med paprika, peberfrugt & kartofler
steps: Brown the pork in batches in the oil in a heavy pot, then add the sliced onions and cook 8 min until soft.
Stir in the paprika, spidskommen, garlic and tomato paste, then the tomatoes, diced carrot and 4 dl water. Cover and simmer 45 min.
Add the pepper strips and simmer 15 min more. Season with salt and pepper.
Boil the potatoes in salted water and serve with a spoon of skyr.

recipes.name: Japanese ginger pork with cabbage
recipes.dk: Shogayaki: ingefærsvinekød med rå spidskål, broccoli & ris
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water, and the broccoli for the last 4 min.
Stir the grated ginger and garlic with the soy sauce, honey and 3 tbsp water.
Fry the pork in the oil on high heat for 3 min, add the sliced onion and the sauce and cook until glossy, 2–3 min.
Shred the cabbage very finely, toss with the grated carrot, lemon juice and a pinch of salt, and serve raw beside the pork, broccoli and rice.

recipes.name: Cabbage rolls in tomato sauce
recipes.dk: Kåldolmere med hakket svinekød i tomatsauce & kartofler
steps: Boil the whole cabbage in salted water for 8 min and peel off 12 soft leaves; shred the rest.
Mix the mince with the uncooked rice, grated onion, egg, salt and pepper. Put a spoonful on each leaf, roll up tightly and lay seam-down in an oven dish on the shredded cabbage.
Pour over the tomatoes mixed with 2 dl water and the thyme, drizzle with the oil and bake covered at 200°C for 50 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water and serve with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Dan dan-style pork noodles
recipes.dk: Kinesiske nudler med sprødt svinekød, peanutsauce & grønt
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says, adding the shredded cabbage and broccoli for the last 2 min, and drain.
Fry the mince in the oil on high heat until crisp, about 8 min, adding the garlic, ginger and chili flakes for the last minute.
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, vinegar, honey and 1.5 dl hot water to a sauce.
Toss the noodles and greens with the sauce and top with the mince, sliced cucumber, grated carrot and chopped nuts.

recipes.name: Pork chops with mustard-roast leeks
recipes.dk: Svinekoteletter med sennepsbagte porrer, æbler & kartofler
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss halved potatoes and carrot chunks with half the oil, the thyme and salt and roast 20 min.
Add the leeks in 4 cm pieces and the apple wedges, toss with most of the mustard and the honey, and roast 15 min more.
Season the pork chops with salt and pepper and fry them in the rest of the oil, 4–5 min per side.
Serve with the vegetables and the skyr stirred with the rest of the mustard.

recipes.name: Spanish paprika pork with roast peppers
recipes.dk: Spansk paprikasvinekød med ovnkartofler & ristet peberfrugtsalat
steps: Toss the pork with the paprika, spidskommen, oregano, half the garlic, half the lemon juice, a third of the oil and some salt, and leave 15 min.
Heat the oven to 220°C. Roast potato chunks and the peppers in strips with another third of the oil and salt for 30–35 min.
Fry the pork in the rest of the oil on high heat, 5–6 min.
Toss the roast peppers with sliced tomatoes and onion, the rest of the garlic and lemon, the vinegar and parsley, and serve with the pork, potatoes and lettuce.

recipes.name: Cumin pork tenderloin with corn salsa
recipes.dk: Spidskommen-mørbrad med søde kartofler, majssalsa & skyr
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss sweet potato wedges with half the oil, half the spidskommen and salt and roast 30 min.
Rub the tenderloin with the rest of the spidskommen, the paprika, salt and pepper, brown it in the rest of the oil, and roast it on the tray for the last 15–18 min to 65°C in the middle.
Dice the tomatoes, pepper and onion and mix with the drained corn, lemon juice, chili flakes and a pinch of salt.
Slice the pork and serve with the sweet potatoes, salsa, lettuce and skyr.

recipes.name: Korean-style beef bowl with quick pickles
recipes.dk: Koreansk skål med hakket oksekød, ris & hurtigsyltet grønt
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Toss the shredded cabbage, carrot strips and sliced cucumber with the vinegar and a pinch of salt and leave to pickle.
Fry the mince in the oil on high heat until browned and crisp, 6–8 min.
Stir in the grated garlic and ginger, chili flakes, soy sauce and honey and cook 2 min until sticky. Build bowls of rice, beef, lettuce and pickled vegetables.

recipes.name: Beef kofta in spiced tomato sauce
recipes.dk: Krydrede oksekofta i tomatsauce med spinat, bulgur & yoghurt
steps: Mix the mince with half the grated onion, half the parsley, the spidskommen, cinnamon, half the garlic, salt and pepper, and shape 12 oval koftas.
Brown them in the oil for 5 min and take them out.
Fry the rest of the onion and garlic and the diced pepper for 4 min, add the paprika and tomatoes, return the koftas and simmer 15 min. Stir in the spinach at the end.
Cook the bulgur in lightly salted water and serve with the yoghurt and the rest of the parsley.

recipes.name: Lighter moussaka with potato & squash
recipes.dk: Moussaka med oksekød, kartofler, squash & yoghurt-æggetop
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Slice the potatoes and squash thinly, toss with half the oil and some salt and bake on trays for 15 min.
Brown the mince with the onion and garlic in the rest of the oil, add the tomato paste, cinnamon, oregano, tomatoes, salt and pepper and simmer 10 min.
Layer potatoes, meat sauce and squash in a dish, ending with vegetables.
Whisk the yoghurt with the eggs and grated cheese, spread it on top and bake 30 min until golden.

recipes.name: Mexican picadillo with rice
recipes.dk: Picadillo: hakket oksekød med kartofler, gulerødder, rosiner & ris
steps: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic in the oil.

Add the spidskommen, cinnamon, oregano and chili flakes, then the diced potatoes, carrots and pepper, the tomatoes, raisins and 2 dl water. Cover and simmer 20 min until the potatoes are tender, and season with salt.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Shred the cabbage finely, toss with a pinch of salt and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Beef & spinach curry
recipes.dk: Indisk oksekarry med spinat, tomat, yoghurt & ris
steps: Brown the beef in batches in the oil in a heavy pot and take it out.
Fry the sliced onions for 8 min until golden, then add the garlic, grated ginger, karry, spidskommen, cinnamon and chili flakes for 1 min.
Return the beef with the tomatoes and 5 dl water, cover and simmer 1¼ hours until tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, take off the heat, stir in the yoghurt and season with salt. Boil the rice in lightly salted water and serve.

recipes.name: Pho-style beef meatball noodle soup
recipes.dk: Vietnamesisk nudelsuppe med oksekødboller, ingefær, kanel & grønt
steps: Halve the onions and char them cut-side down in a dry pot for 5 min, then add the sliced ginger, garlic, cinnamon, soy sauce, salt and 2 l water and simmer 20 min.
Roll the mince into 24 small balls with wet hands.
Lift out the onion and ginger, add the meatballs, sliced mushrooms and carrot strips and simmer 8 min.
Cook the noodles as the pack says and divide them into bowls with the shredded cabbage and lettuce.
Ladle over the hot soup and top with basil, lemon juice and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Carrot, ginger & red lentil soup
recipes.dk: Gulerodssuppe med røde linser, ingefær & karry
steps: Soften the chopped onion, garlic and grated ginger in the oil with the curry powder for 3 min.
Add the sliced carrots, rinsed lentils, coconut milk, salt and 1.2 l water. Simmer 20 min.
Blend smooth, stir in the lemon juice and serve with rye bread. Keeps 4 days.

recipes.name: Cauliflower & white bean soup
recipes.dk: Blomkålssuppe med hvide bønner, timian & rugbrød
steps: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the oil with the thyme.
Add the cauliflower florets, diced potatoes, drained beans, salt and 1 l water. Simmer 20 min.
Blend smooth, season with salt and pepper and top with chopped parsley. Serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Broccoli, spinach & feta frittata
recipes.dk: Frittata med broccoli, spinat & feta i skiver
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Fry the onion and small broccoli florets in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 5 min, then wilt in the spinach.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and crumble over the feta.
Cook 3 min on the hob, then bake 15 min until set. Cut into 8 slices and eat warm or cold with rye bread.

recipes.name: Curried chicken & rice salad
recipes.dk: Rissalat med kylling, karry, æble & peberfrugt
steps: Boil the rice in salted water, rinse in cold water and drain well.
Season the chicken with salt and half the curry powder, fry in the oil 5–6 min per side, cool and dice.
Stir the skyr with the rest of the curry powder, the lemon juice and black pepper.
Mix everything with the diced apple and bell pepper and the finely sliced leek. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Roast vegetable & chickpea bulgur
recipes.dk: Bulgur med ovnbagte grøntsager, kikærter & feta
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the chopped squash, pepper, onion and drained chickpeas with half the oil, the cumin, paprika and salt, and roast 25 min.
Cook the bulgur as the pack says.
Mix with the roast vegetables, lemon juice, the rest of the oil and chopped parsley, and crumble over the feta. Good warm or cold.

recipes.name: Chicken & vegetable meatballs with dill dip
recipes.dk: Kyllingefrikadeller med grønt, skyr-dip & rugbrød
steps: Grate the squash and carrot and squeeze out the liquid. Mix with the mince, grated onion, oats, egg, salt and pepper.
Shape 16 meatballs and fry in the oil, 4–5 min per side, until cooked through.
Stir the skyr with the chopped dill and a pinch of salt. Pack with cucumber sticks and rye bread; the meatballs are good cold.

recipes.name: Shrimp & egg on rye
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med rejer, æg, dild & citron
steps: Boil the egg 8 min, cool and slice.
Spread the rye thinly with skyr, add lettuce, then the egg slices and the shrimp.
Finish with lemon juice, dill and black pepper, with cucumber on the side.

recipes.name: Tuna & white bean salad
recipes.dk: Salat med tun, hvide bønner, tomat & persille
steps: Drain the tuna and rinse the beans.
Mix with the chopped tomato, cucumber, finely chopped onion and parsley.
Dress with the lemon juice, oil, salt and black pepper. A slice of rye on the side.

recipes.name: Smoked fish potato salad
recipes.dk: Kartoffelsalat med røget fisk, dild & sennep
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water, cool and cut into chunks.
Stir the skyr with the mustard, lemon juice, chopped dill and black pepper.
Toss with the potatoes, diced cucumber and finely chopped onion, and flake the smoked fish on top over the lettuce.

recipes.name: Chicken & mushroom salad on rye
recipes.dk: Hønsesalat med skyr, champignon & porre på rugbrød
steps: Season the chicken with salt, fry in the oil 5–6 min per side, cool and dice. Fry the sliced mushrooms in the same pan for 3 min.
Mix the chicken, mushrooms and finely sliced leek with the skyr, mustard, lemon juice and black pepper.
Spread on two slices of rye over lettuce and top with sliced tomato.

recipes.name: Beetroot, apple & cottage cheese rye
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med hytteost, rå rødbede, æble & nødder
steps: Coarsely grate the beetroot and apple and toss them together.
Top two slices of rye with lettuce, the cottage cheese and the beetroot mix.
Scatter over chopped nuts, chives and black pepper.

recipes.name: Peanut chicken noodle salad
recipes.dk: Kold nudelsalat med kylling, kål & peanutdressing
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says, rinse in cold water and drain.
Fry the chicken in the oil with a pinch of salt, 5–6 min per side, then cool and slice.
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lemon juice, grated ginger, chili flakes and 2 tbsp water.
Toss the noodles with the shredded cabbage, carrot and cucumber, the dressing and the chicken.

recipes.name: Greek chicken box with tzatziki
recipes.dk: Kylling med oregano, græsk salat, tzatziki & rugbrød
steps: Rub the chicken with oregano, lemon juice, salt and half the oil, fry 5–6 min per side and slice.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze it dry and stir it into the skyr with the crushed garlic.
Chop the tomato, the rest of the cucumber and the onion, dress with the rest of the oil and top with the feta.
Pack with the chicken, the tzatziki and a slice of rye.

recipes.name: Hummus box with eggs & veg sticks
recipes.dk: Hjemmelavet hummus med æg, grøntsagsstave & rugbrød
steps: Blend the drained chickpeas with the lemon juice, garlic, oil, cumin, salt and 2–3 tbsp water until smooth.
Boil the eggs 8 min, cool and halve them.
Pack the hummus with the eggs, carrot and pepper sticks and a slice of rye.

recipes.name: Spinach & mushroom omelette
recipes.dk: Omelet med spinat, champignon & ost
steps: Fry the sliced mushrooms in the oil for 4 min, then add the spinach and let it wilt.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, pour over and cook on low heat until just set.
Lay the cheese on one half, fold over and serve with sliced tomato and rye bread.

recipes.name: Baked sweet potato with spiced beans
recipes.dk: Bagt sød kartoffel med krydrede bønner, majs & skyr
steps: Prick the sweet potato and bake at 200°C for 45–50 min until soft.
Warm the drained beans and corn in the oil with the cumin, paprika, chili flakes and salt.
Split the potato, fill with the beans, chopped tomato and onion, and top with skyr and a squeeze of lemon. Salad on the side.

recipes.name: Soy-ginger salmon rice box
recipes.dk: Laks med soja & ingefær, ris, broccoli & agurkesalat
steps: Boil the rice. Heat the oven to 200°C.
Stir the soy sauce, grated ginger and honey together, brush over the salmon and bake 12–15 min. Boil the broccoli florets 3 min.
Slice the cucumber thinly and toss with the vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Pack the rice with the salmon, broccoli and cucumber salad; good warm or cold.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin on rye with red cabbage
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med mørbrad, rå rødkålssalat & æble
steps: Season the pork with salt and pepper and fry in the oil 4–5 min per side until just cooked through. Rest and slice.
Finely shred the red cabbage and toss with the grated apple, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Pile the cabbage and pork on two slices of rye and finish with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken lettuce cups with rice
recipes.dk: Salatblade med krydret hakket kylling, ris & grønt
steps: Boil the rice.
Fry the mince in the oil until crumbly, add the chopped onion and garlic and fry 2 min more.
Take off the heat and stir in the soy sauce, lemon juice, chili flakes and chopped chives.
Spoon into lettuce leaves with cucumber and grated carrot, with the rice on the side.

recipes.name: Tomato, mozzarella & white bean salad
recipes.dk: Tomatsalat med mozzarella, hvide bønner & basilikum
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella and mix with the drained beans and torn basil.
Dress with the oil, vinegar, salt and pepper and serve on lettuce with a slice of rye.

recipes.name: Turkish eggs on garlic skyr
recipes.dk: Pocherede æg på hvidløgsskyr med paprikasmør & rugbrød
steps: Stir the skyr with the crushed garlic and a pinch of salt and spread it in a shallow bowl.
Poach the eggs 3–4 min in barely simmering water with the vinegar.
Melt the butter with the paprika and chili flakes. Put the eggs on the skyr, pour over the butter and scatter with dill.
Serve with rye bread and the salad.

recipes.name: Chicken, corn & bean salad
recipes.dk: Salat med krydret kylling, bønner, majs & avocado
steps: Rub the chicken with the cumin, paprika and salt, fry in half the oil 5–6 min per side and slice.
Mix the drained beans and corn with the diced pepper, tomato, onion and avocado on the lettuce.
Dress with the lemon juice, the rest of the oil and a pinch of salt, and top with the chicken.

recipes.name: Apple-cinnamon baked oats
recipes.dk: Bagt havregrød med æble, kanel & nødder (til 4 morgener)
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Whisk the eggs with the milk, cinnamon, baking powder and salt.
Stir in the oats and half the chopped fruit, and pour into an oven dish.
Scatter over the rest of the fruit and the chopped nuts, and bake 30 min until set.
Cut into 4 pieces. They keep 4 days in the fridge; eat cold or warmed.

recipes.name: Rye bread porridge (øllebrød-style)
recipes.dk: Rugbrødsgrød med mælk, kanel & skyr
steps: Break the rye bread into a small pot with 1 dl water and leave 10 min (or overnight) to soften.
Add the milk and cinnamon and simmer 5 min, stirring and mashing, until smooth.
Grate in a little lemon zest and serve topped with the cold skyr.

recipes.name: Spinach & feta omelette
recipes.dk: Omelet med spinat, feta & tomat på rugbrød
steps: Wilt the spinach in the oil in a frying pan.
Pour over the beaten eggs, crumble in the feta and cook on low heat until just set. Season with black pepper.
Serve with the sliced tomato and a slice of rye.

recipes.name: Kvark with warm cinnamon apples
recipes.dk: Kvark med stegte kanelæbler, havregryn & nødder
steps: Fry the diced apple in the butter with the cinnamon, 4–5 min until soft.
Toast the oats and chopped nuts in the same pan for 1 min.
Spoon over the cold kvark.

recipes.name: Apple-cinnamon porridge with nuts
recipes.dk: Havregrød med revet æble, kanel & nødder
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk with the grated apple, cinnamon and a pinch of salt for 5 min, stirring.
Top with the chopped nuts.

recipes.name: Savoury cottage cheese bowl
recipes.dk: Hytteost med agurk, tomat, krydderurter & rugbrød
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and top with diced tomato and cucumber.
Scatter over the chopped herbs, drizzle with the oil and season with black pepper.
Eat with a slice of rye.

recipes.name: Oat rolls with cottage cheese
recipes.dk: Hjemmebagte havreboller med hytteost & tomat (frys resten)
steps: Dissolve the yeast in 4 dl lukewarm water, then knead in the oats, oil, salt and flour to a soft dough.
Let it rise 45 min, shape into 12 rolls on a baking tray and rise 20 min more.
Bake at 220°C for 15 min. Freeze what you will not eat in 2 days.
Serve 2 rolls per person with cottage cheese and sliced tomato.

recipes.name: Nordic breakfast plate
recipes.dk: Morgenanretning: rugbrød, kogt æg, ost, skyr med bær & agurk
steps: Boil the egg 8 min, cool it in cold water and halve it with a pinch of salt.
Lay out the rye bread, cheese and sliced cucumber on a plate.
Serve the skyr in a small bowl with the fruit.

recipes.name: Spinach, banana & ginger smoothie
recipes.dk: Grøn smoothie med spinat, banan, ingefær & skyr
steps: Blend the spinach, banana, skyr, oats, milk and grated ginger until smooth.
Add a splash of water if it is too thick.

recipes.name: Banana, peanut & oat shake
recipes.dk: Shake med banan, peanutbutter, havregryn & skyr
steps: Blend everything with a pinch of cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into a glass or a bottle to take with you.

recipes.name: Bulgur breakfast bowl with egg
recipes.dk: Bulgur med æg, tomat, agurk, persille & feta
steps: Pour 1 dl boiling water over the bulgur with the salt, cover and leave 10 min.
Meanwhile boil the egg 7 min and cool it in cold water.
Fluff the bulgur with the lemon juice, oil and chopped parsley.
Top with diced tomato and cucumber, crumbled feta and the halved egg.

recipes.name: Kvark-oat pancakes with berries
recipes.dk: Proteinpandekager med kvark, havregryn & bær
steps: Blend the kvark, eggs, oats, baking powder and a pinch of salt to a thick batter and rest 5 min.
Fry small pancakes in the oil over medium heat, 2 min per side.
Serve topped with the berries.

recipes.name: Mushrooms & poached egg on rye
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med stegte champignoner, spinat & pocheret æg
steps: Fry the sliced mushrooms in the butter with the garlic, thyme and salt for 5 min, then wilt in the spinach.
Poach the egg 3 min in barely simmering water.
Pile the mushrooms on the rye and top with the egg.

recipes.name: Homemade tomato beans with egg on rye
recipes.dk: Hjemmelavede bønner i tomat med spejlæg & rugbrød (til 4 morgener)
steps: Soften the chopped onion in half the oil, then add the paprika and tomato paste.
Add the drained beans, tomatoes and salt and simmer 15 min until thick. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
Each morning, fry an egg in a little of the remaining oil and serve it on a slice of rye with a quarter of the warmed beans.

recipes.name: Boller i karry
recipes.dk: Boller i karry med porrer, æble & ris
steps: Mix the mince with the grated onion, egg, 3 tbsp of the flour, the milk, salt and pepper. Rest 10 min.
Bring 1 l salted water to a simmer, drop in walnut-sized balls with a spoon and poach 10 min. Lift them out and keep 6 dl of the water.
Boil the rice.
Melt the butter, fry the karry and sliced leek 2 min, stir in the rest of the flour, then whisk in the saved water and the cream. Simmer 5 min.
Add the meatballs and diced apple, heat through 3 min and season with salt.

recipes.name: Brændende kærlighed
recipes.dk: Kartoffelmos med sprød bacon, stegte løg & rødbeder
steps: Boil the beetroot 35–40 min until tender, slice and pour over the vinegar mixed with the sugar and a pinch of salt.
Boil the potatoes in salted water, 20 min.
Fry the bacon crisp, then cook the sliced onions in the bacon fat for 10 min until golden.
Mash the potatoes with the warm milk and butter and season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with the bacon and onions, with the beetroot on the side.

recipes.name: Frikadeller with brown sauce
recipes.dk: Frikadeller med brun sovs, kartofler & lun rødkål
steps: Mix the mince with the grated onion, egg, flour, milk, salt and pepper and rest 15 min.
Shred the red cabbage and simmer it covered with the vinegar, sugar, a pinch of salt and 1 dl water for 25 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Shape 12 frikadeller with a wet spoon and fry them in the butter on medium heat, 5–6 min per side.
Warm the brown sauce in the pan and serve.

recipes.name: Meatloaf with bacon & cream gravy
recipes.dk: Forloren hare med bacon, flødesovs & agurkesalat
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Mix the mince with the grated onion, egg, oats, milk, salt and pepper.
Shape into a loaf in a roasting dish, press the bacon over the top and roast 50 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water. Slice the cucumber thinly and mix with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Pour the juices from the dish into a pan with the cream, whisk in the flour stirred into a little cold water and simmer 3 min. Season with salt and pepper and serve with the sliced meatloaf.

recipes.name: Skipperlabskovs
recipes.dk: Skipperlabskovs med smør, purløg, rødbeder & rugbrød
steps: Brown the beef with the chopped onions in a third of the butter in a large pot. Add 1 l water, the salt and 1 tsp black pepper and simmer covered for 1 hour.
Add the potatoes in chunks and simmer 25 min more, stirring now and then, until they fall apart and thicken the stew.
Meanwhile boil the beetroot until tender, slice and dress with the vinegar and sugar.
Serve with a knob of the remaining butter on each plate, chopped chives and more pepper, with rye bread.

recipes.name: Toast tartlets with creamy chicken
recipes.dk: Tarteletter af toastbrød med høns i flødesovs
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the crusts off 12 slices of bread, roll each thin, brush with half the butter and press into a muffin tin. Bake 10–12 min until golden.
Fry the diced chicken, sliced mushrooms and diced carrots in the rest of the butter for 5 min.
Sprinkle over the flour, stir in the cream and milk and simmer 8 min. Season with salt and pepper.
Fill the toast cups and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken pasta bake
recipes.dk: Pastagratin med kylling, champignon & broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Boil the pasta in salted water for 2 min less than the packet says, adding the broccoli florets for the last 2 min.
Fry the diced chicken, sliced mushrooms and garlic in the oil for 6 min. Season with salt and pepper.
Mix the pasta, broccoli, chicken and cream in a dish, top with the grated cheese and bake 20 min until golden.

recipes.name: Mac & cheese with bacon
recipes.dk: Ovnbagt makaroni i ostesauce med bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Boil the pasta in salted water for 2 min less than the packet says and drain.
Fry the bacon crisp.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the milk, and simmer 5 min. Stir in three-quarters of the cheese and the mustard and season with salt and pepper.
Mix the pasta, bacon and sauce in a dish, top with the rest of the cheese and bake 15–20 min. Serve with sliced tomatoes.

recipes.name: Spaghetti & meatballs
recipes.dk: Pasta med kødboller i tomatsauce & revet ost
steps: Mix the mince with the egg, oats, half the garlic, salt and pepper and roll 20 meatballs.
Brown them in the oil for 6–8 min and lift them out.
Soften the chopped onion and the rest of the garlic in the pan, add the tomato paste, tomatoes and oregano and simmer 10 min. Return the meatballs and simmer 10 min more.
Boil the pasta in salted water. Serve with the sauce, torn basil and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Pork schnitzel with fried potatoes
recipes.dk: Paneret svineschnitzel med brasede kartofler, ærter & citron
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 min, cool a little, slice and fry them golden in the oil for 10 min. Salt them.
Cut the tenderloin into 8 slices and flatten each to 0.5 cm between baking paper. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then finely crushed oats.
Fry in the butter on medium heat, 3 min per side. Boil the vegetables 3 min and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Chicken legs with potato gratin
recipes.dk: Kyllingelår med flødekartofler & salat
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Slice the potatoes thinly and layer them in a dish with the crushed garlic, thyme, salt and pepper.
Pour over the cream and milk, top with the cheese and bake 1 hour.
Season the chicken legs with salt and paprika and roast them on a rack above the gratin for the last 45 min.
Serve with salad and sliced cucumber.

recipes.name: Danish hotdogs
recipes.dk: Pølser i brød med ristede løg, sennep & syltede agurker
steps: Slice the cucumber thinly and mix with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt. Leave 15 min.
Slice half the onions thinly, toss in the flour and fry in the oil on medium heat until crisp and brown, 8–10 min. Drain on paper and salt lightly. Chop the rest finely.
Heat the sausages in simmering water for 5 min, or fry them.
Warm the rolls, split them and fill each with a sausage, mustard, raw and crispy onions and the cucumber.

recipes.name: Nachos tortilla bake
recipes.dk: Ovnbagte nachos med krydret kød, bønner & ost
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the tortillas into triangles, toss with the oil and bake on two trays for 8 min until crisp.
Brown the mince, stir in the tacokrydderi, the drained beans and the tomatoes and simmer 8 min.
Spread the crisps in a large dish, spoon over the meat, top with the cheese and bake 8–10 min until melted.
Scatter over the chopped tomato and onion with a pinch of salt, and serve with creme fraiche.

recipes.name: Jacket potatoes with chili & cheese
recipes.dk: Bagte kartofler med chili, ost & creme fraiche
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Prick 4 large potatoes, rub with a little salt and bake 60 min until soft.
Brown the mince with the chopped onion and garlic in the oil, add the chili flakes, cumin and paprika, then the tomatoes and drained beans. Simmer 20 min and season with salt.
Split the potatoes, fill with the chili and top with cheese, creme fraiche and chopped chives.

recipes.name: Crispy chicken burgers with coleslaw
recipes.dk: Burger med sprød kylling, ost & coleslaw
steps: Cut the chicken into 4 thin fillets and season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then crushed oats, and fry in the oil on medium heat, 4–5 min per side. Put the cheese on for the last minute.
Mix the shredded cabbage and grated carrot with the creme fraiche, mustard and a pinch of salt.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with salad, tomato, chicken and coleslaw.

recipes.name: Calzone with mince & mozzarella
recipes.dk: Indbagt pizza med kødfyld, champignon & mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 230°C. Brown the mince with the chopped onion and sliced mushrooms in the oil, add half the tomatoes, the oregano and salt and simmer 5 min.
Divide the dough into 4, roll each into a circle and spread with the rest of the tomatoes.
Put the filling and torn mozzarella on one half, fold over and press the edges together.
Bake 15–18 min until golden. Serve with salad.

recipes.name: Chicken & spinach lasagne
recipes.dk: Lasagne med kylling, spinat & ostesauce
steps: Brown the chicken mince with the chopped onion and garlic, add the tomatoes, thyme, salt and pepper and simmer 10 min. Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the milk and cream, simmer 5 min and stir in half the cheese. Season with salt.
Layer chicken sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce three times in a dish and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 35–40 min.

recipes.name: Chicken & broccoli tart
recipes.dk: Tærte med kylling, broccoli & ost
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a tart tin with the pastry and bake it blind for 10 min.
Fry the diced chicken and onion in the oil for 5 min and blanch the broccoli florets for 2 min. Spread both in the case.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, cheese, salt and pepper, pour over and bake 30–35 min until set.
Serve with salad and tomatoes.

recipes.name: Sticky honey-soy chicken
recipes.dk: Klistrede kyllingelår med honning & soja, ris & broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Mix the honey, soy sauce, sugar, oil, crushed garlic and grated ginger.
Toss the chicken legs in half the glaze and roast skin up for 45 min, brushing with the rest of the glaze twice.
Boil the rice. Boil the broccoli 4 min with a pinch of salt.
Spoon the sticky juices from the tin over the chicken and rice.

recipes.name: Bacon fried rice
recipes.dk: Stegt ris med bacon, æg & grøntsager
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water, spread it out and let it cool (day-old rice is best).
Fry the bacon crisp in a large pan, then add the oil, chopped onion and garlic for 2 min.
Add the rice and frozen vegetables and fry on high heat for 5 min, stirring.
Push everything to one side, scramble the eggs in the pan and mix in. Season with soy sauce and top with chives.

recipes.name: Sausage stroganoff
recipes.dk: Pølsegryde med fløde, tomat & paprika og ris
steps: Boil the rice.
Fry the sliced sausages, chopped onion and diced pepper in the oil for 5 min.
Stir in the tomato paste and paprika, then the cream and 1 dl water. Simmer 10 min and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Fish & chips
recipes.dk: Fisk i dej med ovnfritter, ærter & dilddip
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into chips, toss with 2 tbsp of the oil and some salt and bake 30–35 min, turning once.
Mix the creme fraiche with diced cucumber, chopped dill, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, milk and a pinch of salt into a thick batter. Dip the salted fish pieces and fry in the rest of the oil, about 1 cm deep, 3–4 min per side.
Boil the vegetables 3 min and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Flæskesteg sandwich
recipes.dk: Flæskestegssandwich med rødkål, agurk & sennep
steps: Cut the pork into thin slices, salt them and fry in a dry pan on medium heat, 4–5 min per side, until the rind crackles.
Shred the red cabbage finely and mix with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Split and butter the rolls and fill with mustard, pork, red cabbage and sliced cucumber.

recipes.name: Club sandwich
recipes.dk: Clubsandwich med kylling, bacon, æg & tomat
steps: Boil the egg 9 min and slice it. Fry the bacon crisp.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper, fry it in the oil 5–6 min per side and slice it.
Toast the bread and mix the creme fraiche with the mustard.
Stack the three slices with dressing, salad, chicken, bacon, tomato and egg, pin with sticks and cut into triangles.

recipes.name: Leverpostej with beetroot & cucumber
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med leverpostej, rødbeder & agurkesalat
steps: Grate the raw beetroot and slice the cucumber thinly. Mix both with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Butter the rye bread, spread thickly with leverpostej and top with the beetroot and cucumber.

recipes.name: Pizza toast
recipes.dk: Pizzatoast med skinke, peberfrugt & mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and toast the bread lightly.
Mix the tomatoes with the tomato paste, oregano and salt and spread on the toast.
Top with ham, diced pepper and torn mozzarella and bake 8–10 min until bubbling.

recipes.name: Chicken quesadillas
recipes.dk: Quesadillas med krydret kylling, ost & majs
steps: Fry the diced chicken in the oil for 5 min and toss with the tacokrydderi and a splash of water.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, cheese, diced pepper and drained corn, and fold them.
Toast in a dry pan, 2 min per side, until the cheese melts. Serve with creme fraiche.

recipes.name: Egg salad & bacon rolls
recipes.dk: Boller med æggesalat & sprød bacon
steps: Boil the eggs 9 min, cool them in cold water and chop.
Fry the bacon crisp.
Mix the eggs with the creme fraiche, mustard, chopped chives, salt and pepper, and fill the split rolls with salad, egg salad and bacon.

recipes.name: Pølsehorn
recipes.dk: Hjemmebagte pølsehorn med agurkestave
steps: Warm the milk with the butter until finger-warm, dissolve the yeast in it and knead with the flour, sugar and salt to a smooth dough. Rise 30 min.
Roll the dough into two circles and cut each into 8 wedges.
Put half a sausage on the wide end of each wedge, roll up, brush with beaten egg and rise 15 min.
Bake at 220°C for 10–12 min until golden. Serve with cucumber sticks; they freeze well for packed lunches.

recipes.name: Tomato soup with grilled cheese
recipes.dk: Cremet tomatsuppe med ostetoast
steps: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the oil for 5 min, add the tomatoes, sugar and 1.5 dl water and simmer 10 min.
Blend smooth, stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Butter the outsides of the bread, fill with the cheese and toast in a pan 3 min per side. Serve with the soup and torn basil.

recipes.name: Warm potato salad with sausages
recipes.dk: Lun kartoffelsalat med pølser
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15–18 min, then slice them while warm.
Mix the creme fraiche with the mustard, vinegar, finely chopped onion, chives, salt and pepper, and fold in the potatoes.
Fry or heat the sausages and serve with the potato salad.

recipes.name: Shrimp & egg on toast
recipes.dk: Rejemad med æg, citron & dild på ristet brød
steps: Boil the egg 9 min, cool and slice.
Toast and butter the bread and lay the salad on top.
Pile on the shrimps and egg, add a spoon of creme fraiche, a squeeze of lemon, dill and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Pariserbøf
recipes.dk: Pariserbøf på stegt brød med æg, løg & rødbeder
steps: Grate the raw beetroot and mix with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Shape the mince into a thin patty the size of the bread, season with salt and pepper and fry in half the butter, 2–3 min per side.
Fry the bread golden in the rest of the butter, then fry the egg in the same pan.
Put the patty on the bread with the egg on top, chopped raw onion and the beetroot.

recipes.name: French toast with berries
recipes.dk: Arme riddere med kanel & bær
steps: Whisk the egg with the milk, cinnamon and half the sugar.
Dip the bread on both sides and fry in the butter on medium heat, 2–3 min per side until golden.
Sprinkle with the rest of the sugar and serve with the berries.

recipes.name: American pancakes
recipes.dk: Amerikanske pandekager med banan & honning
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then whisk in the egg, milk and half the melted butter to a thick batter.
Fry small, thick pancakes in the rest of the butter on medium heat, 2 min per side until risen and golden.
Stack them with sliced banana and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Full breakfast
recipes.dk: Engelsk morgenmad med pølse, bacon, æg, bønner & toast
steps: Fry the sausage and bacon in the oil for 8 min, then add the halved tomato and sliced mushrooms to the pan for 4 min.
Heat the drained beans with the chopped tomatoes and a pinch of salt and pepper for 5 min.
Fry the egg in the pan and serve everything with buttered toast.

recipes.name: Cinnamon toast with apple
recipes.dk: Ristet brød med kanelsmør & æble
steps: Mix the soft butter with the sugar and cinnamon.
Toast the bread, spread with the cinnamon butter and put under the oven grill for 1–2 min until bubbling.
Serve with the apple in slices.

recipes.name: Breakfast burrito
recipes.dk: Wrap med røræg, bacon, peberfrugt & ost
steps: Fry the bacon and diced pepper for 4 min.
Add the butter and the beaten eggs with salt and pepper, and stir gently until just set.
Fill the warmed tortilla with the eggs and cheese, roll it up and toast it seam-side down for 1 min.

recipes.name: Ham & cheese omelette
recipes.dk: Omelet med skinke & ost og ristet brød
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Melt half the butter in a pan, pour in the eggs and cook on medium heat for 2 min, pulling the edges in.
Scatter over the ham and cheese, fold the omelette and cook 1 min more. Serve with toast spread with the rest of the butter and sliced tomato.

recipes.name: Cheese scones
recipes.dk: Hurtige ostescones med smør
steps: Heat the oven to 225°C. Rub 20 g of the butter into the flour, baking powder and salt.
Stir in most of the cheese and the milk to a soft dough, pat into 2 scones and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake 12–15 min until golden. Serve warm with the rest of the butter.
